purpose: Set a deadline for completing an action.
keywords: I want to reach the station by nine.
Let us finish preparing before the teacher arrives.
restrictions: The action happens by the endpoint; it need not continue throughout the interval.
mistake: Use まで for an activity continuing until a time.
